summary: security checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for the managed fleet; blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private-preview evidence work and ordinary reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor is unavailable, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps have no results, security site checks are absent, and authentication boundaries, secret handling, container isolation, release provenance, dependency exposure, data exposure, incident telemetry, and disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance records 35 pass, 13 fail, and 11 unknown across 59 sites; this is not a security certification. Existing failed implementation signals include 8 failed requests and 19 repair items, but they do not prove exploitation or a security defect. Exact decision: continue only bounded read-only evidence capture, existing measurement gates, failed-request repair or closure, and the private launch gate. Do not authorize public launch, credential changes, production security configuration changes, new data collection, or external disclosure outreach. Do not block ordinary reversible growth solely for optional hardening when normal preview, build, smoke, compliance, and rollback gates pass.

SearchWoot security decision: blocked for public beta and full launch. API access is documented, but redistribution rights, data-flow and retention controls, consent/configuration evidence, logging/vendor controls, incident handling, accuracy/freshness, attribution, and owner approval remain incomplete. Maintain private access and permit only bounded read-only evidence work or draft internal preparation.

Control interpretation: no clean bill of health is supported. TLS has no recorded certificates expiring within 30 days, but certificate validity and configuration are otherwise unevidenced. The bounded repository-lab checks did not install dependencies, access production, or establish fleet-wide supply-chain safety. Missing security.txt or disclosure evidence is a readiness gap, not proof of vulnerability.
